title: AgentsConfig
description: config/agents.yaml: the harness's role limits (PRD 8.1, FR-AGT-01), context thresholds and liveness timings (8.5, FR-AGT-09, FR-AGT-10), retries (FR-AGT-13) and question load control (8.3). Values the PRD fixes are const; the rest are bounded so config cannot loosen a stated limit.

max_specialists.description: Specialists running at once in one world, at most 6 (PRD 8.1).

max_depth.description: Agent levels below the owner (PRD 8.1: capped at three).

context.description: Share of an agent's context window (PRD 8.5). handoff_at is fixed at 0.70 (D-08, FR-AGT-09), so 0 < compact_at < handoff_at < 1 reduces to compact_at below 0.70 (BQ-58).

handoff_at.description: Fixed at 0.70; minimum and maximum repeat the const so generated Python checks it too.

liveness.description: Crash recovery (PRD 8.5, FR-AGT-10): each agent sends a heartbeat every heartbeat_s seconds; the sweeper restarts an agent silent for silent_after_s seconds from its last checkpoint. The harness loader also requires silent_after_s > heartbeat_s.

retries.description: Attempts per unit, the first included; after max_attempts failures the unit escalates (FR-AGT-13), which is the PRD 8.3 must-ask 'a unit fails 3 times', so at most 3.

questions.description: Load control (PRD 8.3): questions to one person per hour before the rest go into a digest.
